# Question fidelity and unique factors of open joining maps

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

A join-preserving map lifting joins at one fixed participant preserves all incidence questions; two such common-refinement projections have a unique join-preserving function to the equally answering pairs commuting with both projections.

Canonical source: [ExplanatoryJoiningRefinement.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/ExplanatoryJoiningRefinement.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Two maps p:L→J and q:L→K from the same L satisfy the explicit OpenMap condition.

The strong OpenMap lifting condition is supplied for a given interpretation; the preceding result derives it for the canonical projections.

## Validation and boundaries

## History

- 2026-10-08: continued the existing joining-context study, with distinct scopes for common refinement, compatible factors, real information loss and retained-reference repair.
- 2026-10-09: reuse this result in finite-granularity continuation; preserve its claim, hypotheses and proof bindings. New prefix omission and resumption testing appear in the same study §§22–26.
- 2026-10-09 continuation: finite guarded programs, residual recovery and 35 checked declarations added in the same study §§27–32; this result retains its claim, assumptions and proof bindings.
- 14 October 2026, integration I3 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): restated on the spine. The new core module Becoming.Joining, importing only Becoming.Likeness, reads a joining of fragments as frames of the spine, through partners, roles and retained references; a description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the partner frame, with no premise (Joining.lifts_iff); Becoming.JoiningBridge reads the joining studies as instances. Open maps of joinings are the open maps of the role frames (Joining.openMap_iff; in the bridge openMap_iff_incidence) and keep likeness and every role test (OpenMap.alike, Joining.OpenMap.sameBranchingTests, openMap_keeps_role_tests); two open maps from one joining factor through it, the factor unique at every fragment (Joining.universal_factor). It differs from the periphery: uniqueness is pointwise, since equality of functions needs funext, and the factor maps into alike pairs rather than equally answering ones. The periphery's incidence step, sameness of answers and span are defined through a match with an overlapping wildcard case (the register study's step through xs[i]?), and their compiled definitions use propext, so no statement mentioning them has an empty axiom report; the claim is therefore restated on the core's role frame (Joining.roleFrame) or retained frame (Joining.retainedFrame), not as a literal instance, the bridge showing that the periphery's open maps and local finiteness are the core's (openMap_iff_incidence, locallyFinite_iff). The periphery's every_exact_account_has_canonical_factor needs funext and propext and stays there. Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing).
- 16 October 2026, landing P110–P112 (study sections 147–149): rebound to the new receipt and rehashed: Joining.lean (P110: the readings decided on Ren's delegation folded into the docstrings (comments only; the code outside comments is unchanged; changed paragraphs refilled at 100 columns)); JoiningBridge.lean (P110: the readings decided on Ren's delegation folded into the docstrings (comments only; the code outside comments is unchanged; changed paragraphs refilled at 100 columns)).
